climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: The nation's smallest AVA, in California, at the confluence of the San Joaquin and Stanislaus Rivers in San Joaquin County. It is cooler than the rest of the Central Valley and is the only place in the valley with lots of fine sandy loam. About 90 percent of it is planted to Chardonnay.
